title: Lemon Drop Boost Salt Nic E-Liquid – Wild Berry
description:
Description
A vibrant explosion of wild berry and zesty lemon, cranked up to the limit for a juicy, tangy vape that overflows with flavour in every puff!
Get ready to crank up the flavour with Lemon Drop Boost Salt – a bold new twist on the classics you love! Crafted with premium ingredients and bursting with tangy lemon goodness, Lemon Drop Boost Salt offers a perfectly balanced 50VG/50PG salt nicotine formula for an ultra-smooth and satisfying experience in any open pod system.
Each 30ml bottle features Lemon Drop’s signature tangy lemon base, now amped up with intensified flavour for a bolder, brighter, and seriously satisfying vape! Dive into your favourite Lemon Drop flavours like Blue Raspberry, Peach, Pink, Punch, and Wild Berry — all dialed up to the max!
Lemon Drop Boost Salt Nic is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Lemon Drop Boost Salt Nic E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
